name: Hypotactic for NLP (Urdatorn/hypotactic): Chamberlain's syllable-quantity-tagged Greek verse
contents: David Chamberlain's Hypotactic corpus of Greek verse with every syllable tagged for quantity, elision, hiatus, synizesis. Greek texts include Pindar (Olympians, Pythians, Nemeans, Isthmians), Theognis, Solon, Tyrtaeus, Semonides, Homer, Hesiod, Hymns, Apollonius, Callimachus, Aratus, Theocritus, Aeschylus (Persians, Seven, Prometheus). Per-text TSV files plus a merged 60,660-line syllabified file; script extract_macrons_from_open_sylls.py pulls vowel lengths of open syllables.
size: ~18 MB repo; hypotactic_all_raw.txt 7.2 MB; per-text TSVs 25-300 KB each
licence: 'The corpus is published on the Hypotactic website under the CC-BY 4.0 licence' (repo README, quoting Chamberlain: 'All the data on this site is/are licensed as CC-BY 4.0 ... I do not intend to place any restrictions that go beyond standard academic attribution conventions')
value_why: Only open, human-made syllable-quantity data for archaic and classical lyric (all of Pindar, Theognis, Solon, Tyrtaeus, Semonides). Gives gold vowel lengths for dichrona in open syllables, directly usable as a quantity lexicon and as a test set for the parser/scansion.
effort_why: Plain text/TSV; need to align lines to Melos editions (text editions differ) and extract per-word quantity patterns. Attribution to Chamberlain and hypotactic.com required.
restrictions: CC BY 4.0, attribution to David Chamberlain and hypotactic.com for significant use. Repo README caveat: syllabification there assumes heterosyllabic mute+liquid across the board (wrong for much epic/lyric); use the original quantity tags, not the re-syllabification. Lyric coverage limited to the listed texts (no Sappho/Alcaeus/Alcman).

name: Hypotactic2Perseus (gregorycrane): converter from Hypotactic HTML to meter TSV
contents: Python converter (hypotactic_to_meter_tsv.py) from Hypotactic HTML/MHTML to a headerless TSV with positions 1-24, hemistich, caesura, diaeresis; input/ and output/ folders.
licence: no licence stated (GitHub reports no licence for the repo); underlying data is Hypotactic CC BY 4.0
value_why: Same data as the Urdatorn repo, but only for hexameter-style layouts.
effort_why: Not needed if Urdatorn/hypotactic is used.
restrictions: No licence on the converter code; do not copy code without asking.

name: Norma Syllabarum Graecarum (Macronizer/norma): hand-annotated vowel-length and syllable-weight benchmark
contents: Benchmark of 1228 lines (14 authors) with ^ (short) and _ (long) marked after every ambiguous alpha/iota/upsilon in open syllables, plus syllable weight. Includes Alcman (Louvre Partheneion 36-49), Bacchylides Ode 5, Aristophanes lyric (299 lines test) and a validation file of 764 lines of Aristophanes lyric; also tragedy, elegy, hexameter, prose.
licence: license: gpl-3.0 (dataset card metadata)
value_why: Small but gold-quality quantity labels for real lyric lines (Alcman, Bacchylides, Aristophanic lyric). Ideal as an evaluation set for any Melos quantity or scansion code.
effort_why: Two JSONL files; just parse markup.
restrictions: GPL-3.0 on a dataset: copyleft; fine for evaluation use, do not mix into a differently licensed published data file without a legal view. Underlying text is from Perseus/First1K editions.

name: OGA Macronized (Macronizer/oga-macronized): silver vowel-length annotation of 2.2M Greek sentences
contents: 2,234,599 sentences of Opera Graeca Adnotata with ^ / _ after dichrona the rule-based grc-macronizer could resolve; unresolved dichrona left unmarked (never guessed). 69.20% of disambiguated dichrona-in-open-syllables macronized (11,627,591 / 16,802,080).
licence: license: gpl-3.0 (card metadata). README: 'The underlying OGA corpus is distributed by its authors under the terms shown on its Zenodo record; check that record for the authoritative license before redistribution. The macronization itself is produced by software licensed under GNU GPL v3.'
value_why: Large per-token quantity layer for all of literary Greek; useful to build a form-to-quantity frequency table to fill gaps. Labels are silver (rule-based, conservative), so lower trust than Hypotactic/Norma.
effort_why: Parquet download of 400 MB; need to map sentence text to Melos lemma/forms.
restrictions: Licence of the redistributed text is ambiguous (GPL-3.0 label over CC BY-SA OGA text). Treat as research input; store derived per-form counts, not the text.

name: grc-macronizer (Urdatorn): rule-based Greek vowel-length annotator with embedded lexical databases
contents: Python package (PyPI grc-macronizer) applying accentuation rules, then lookup in bundled databases: grc_macronizer/db has lsj.py (1.8 MB), lsj_keys.py (3.8 MB), crawl_lsj.py, hypotactic.pkl (2 MB), ionic.py, custom.py, proper_names.py (3.5 MB), wiktionary_ambiguous.py (1.1 MB), wiktionary_singletons.py (55 MB); uses OdyCy for morphological disambiguation. docs/method.md explains the pipeline.
licence: 'This repository is under the copyleft GNU GPL 3 license' (README, (C) Albin Thorn Cleland)
value_why: The only complete open pipeline for dichrona length: Wiktionary macron data, LSJ-derived length keys and Hypotactic scansion merged into form lookup tables. The method note is a ready design for a Melos quantity layer. Cited paper: Thorn Cleland and Cullhed, Automatic Annotation of Ancient Greek Vowel Length (arXiv 2608.01935).
effort_why: Installable with Python 3.12; the db files can be mined for form-to-length mappings, but their provenance (LSJ crawl, Wiktionary, Hypotactic) must be traced to the original licences before reuse.
restrictions: GPL-3.0. The bundled db files embed third-party data (LSJ crawl of unknown source, Wiktionary CC BY-SA, Hypotactic CC BY); the repo licence does not clear these. Treat as a method reference; prefer re-deriving data from the original open sources.

name: grc-macronizer-oga (Urdatorn): macronizing OGA via its own annotations
contents: Scripts and examples (example_macronized.txt, oga_conllu_ud.7z) that convert OGA/PROIEL annotation into the macronizer's UD representation and run the macronizer over all OGA.
licence: 'This repository is under the copyleft GNU GPL 3 license' (README)
value_why: Companion to the dataset; useful only to reproduce it.
effort_why: Heavy pipeline, not needed if the dataset is used.

name: oga-macronizer-char and Stoicheia macronizer/meter models (HF)
contents: Small char-level transformers predicting short/long for ambiguous alpha/iota/upsilon: Macronizer/oga-macronizer-char (0.87M params, safetensors) and Ericu950/Stoicheia-macronizer / Stoicheia-meter / CharDiff-grc-meter (405M params; trained on a silver corpus of ~130,000 verse lines built by exact constraint propagation). Norma accuracy for CharDiff reported 0.936.
licence: oga-macronizer-char: license gpl-3.0; Stoicheia-macronizer and Stoicheia-meter: license apache-2.0 (model-card metadata). Stoicheia card: 'Anonymous release accompanying a paper under review.'
value_why: Lets Melos predict dichrona length on any text, including unscanned fragments, and flag lines where it disagrees with the metre. Fills gaps where no lexical quantity is known.
effort_why: transformers + trust_remote_code for Stoicheia; the small char model is easy to run on CPU.
restrictions: Anonymous (under review) release; trained partly on silver labels. Predictions must be shown as machine guesses, not data.

name: Diorisis Scan (alevatri/diorisisscan): metrical scanner with greekScansions.json form-to-quantity table
contents: Python module for scanning Ancient Greek metre; ships greekScansions.json (21 MB), a Beta-code dictionary of word forms to syllable quantity patterns (e.g. '!a/bais': [[0,'-']]) with per-syllable long/short/anceps symbols.
licence: MIT License, Copyright (c) 2022 alevatri (LICENSE)
value_why: A ready form-level quantity table across the Diorisis vocabulary; can seed vowel-length look-up and cross-check Morpheus output. Name suggests it was derived from Diorisis forms.
effort_why: Single JSON file, Beta code, easy to convert to Unicode.
restrictions: MIT covers the repo; the JSON file's provenance (how quantities were derived, from which lexica) is NOT stated. Ask the author before relying on it, and spot-check against Hypotactic/Norma.

name: Eulexis off-line data (PhVerkerk/Eulexis_off_line): form-to-lemma analyses with quantity marks, LSJ, Pape, Bailly
contents: analyses_gr.txt (77.8 MB; lines such as '*!rei/as {*(rei/a_s,*(re/a fem gen sg (attic epic doric aeolic)}' - Beta-code form, lemma, parse with dialect tags, vowel length marked as a_ in the forms), LSJ-6.5.1.txt (35 MB), Pape.3.1.txt (25 MB, 3rd ed. German), Bailly.Abr.5.1.txt (13 MB, abridged Bailly), trad_gr_en_fr_de.csv (5.8 MB short translations).
size: ~160 MB of data in the repo
licence: Repository LICENSE: GNU GPL v3 (software). Eulexis page: 'The Eulexis software is developed by Philippe Verkerk and is made available under the GNU GPL v3 license.' No separate statement for the data files in the repo.
value_why: analyses_gr.txt is a very large pre-computed Morpheus/Diogenes-style form table with dialect tags (epic, doric, aeolic, ionic) and macron-marked forms; could be used offline in place of live Morpheus calls and to extract quantities. Pape and the abridged Bailly are ready text files.
effort_why: Beta-code parsing; need to determine the licence of each component first (see restrictions).
restrictions: Data licence not stated. Biblissima page says of the full Bailly 2020: 'not being released under a free license, but nevertheless usable under conditions, we preferred not to make it downloadable here'. The page credits the Pape and LSJ text to Philipp Roelli, corrected by Chaerephon (Andre Charbonnet); the analyses come 'with files from Diogenes and Perseus' (Perseus data CC BY-SA 3.0, Diogenes GPLv3). Ask Verkerk/Biblissima before ingesting. Do not treat as cleared.

name: Bailly 2020 'Hugo Chavez' (Gerard Greco et al.): Greek-French dictionary
contents: Revised, corrected digital Bailly 1935 (about 2600 pages), free PDF; TeX/HTML conversions exist (Eulexis, bailly.app).
licence: 'distribuees sous licence Creative Commons Attribution - Pas d'Utilisation Commerciale - Pas de Modification (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0)' (bailly.app README); CLD page: 'Licence Creative Commons Attribution - Pas d'Utilisation Commerciale - Pas de Modification - CC BY-NC-ND 4.0'. Biblissima: 'not being released under a free license, but nevertheless usable under conditions'.
value_why: Best French Greek lexicon with a large citation set; many lyric words. But ND and NC terms block building a derived searchable dataset on greeklyric.com.
effort_why: Would need written permission from Gerard Greco before any ingestion; the licence text itself could not be fetched from the original site (gerardgreco.free.fr connection refused/404 on article52 on 2026-10-09; the notice PDF at bailly.app has no licence text).
restrictions: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 as stated by two independent re-users: no commercial use, no derivatives. Owner decision: ask the Greco team for permission, otherwise link out only.

name: bailly.app (defense-humanites): Nuxt web app for Bailly 2020 using libmorpheus
contents: Open web app (AGPL-3.0) serving Bailly 2020; uses libmorpheus (Antoine Boquet) - a modernised build of Perseus Morpheus; fonts under SIL OFL.
licence: GNU Affero General Public License v3 (code, LICENSE); data: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; 'libmorpheus est distribuee sous licence mixte, Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL-2.0) et GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 or later'
value_why: libmorpheus (MPL-2.0/AGPL) is a maintained packaging of Morpheus that may be easier to embed than the Alpheios build.
effort_why: Check libmorpheus repo licence and stemlib licence separately.
restrictions: AGPL on the app; data NC-ND.

name: Classical Language Dictionary (CLD, BBAW/TELOTA) with public API
contents: Berlin-Brandenburg Academy aggregator: word lists from Diogenes and Scaife, Bailly 2020, LSJ and Pape (digital versions by Chaerephon/Charbonnet via Biblissima/Eulexis), DGRBM (Smith, PD), LGPN, TBESG (Abbott-Smith based), TIPNR; JSON API with OpenAPI document and rate limit; Dictionary Analyzer (spaCy NLP).
licence: 'All page content is subject to the Creative Commons licence CC-BY 4.0 unless otherwise stated.' Per-dictionary licences are listed at /documentation/dictionaries ('as long as they are free to use'); Bailly is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
value_why: A convenient lookup of Pape/LSJ/Bailly, but the aggregated data are not under one open licence and the service is early-stage ('Coming soon').
effort_why: API terms of use not stated beyond rate limit; do not bulk-call without asking BBAW/TELOTA.
restrictions: Contains NC-ND Bailly. API rate-limited (HTTP 429). robots.txt allows all. Ask before any bulk use.

name: latin-dict/Bailly2020 (GitHub)
contents: Repository with only a 12-byte README.md; no Bailly XML/TEI conversion exists there.
licence: no licence stated
value_why: Empty; searched for any Bailly 2020 XML/TEI on GitHub and found none.
effort_why: Nothing to ingest.
restrictions: None.

name: DGE - Diccionario Griego-Espanol (alpha to exauos) and LMPG
contents: CSIC Greek-Spanish dictionary: ~60,000 entries, ~370,000 citations, letters alpha to exauos, TEI P5 XML; LMPG (Lexicon of the magical papyri) on the same site. xDGE project on SourceForge hosts the TEI text and serving software (last update 2016-04-04).
licence: 'distribuidos bajo la licencia Creative Commons: Reconocimiento - No Comercial - Compartir Igual; 3.0 Espana License'. 'No Comercial: Queremos fomentar el uso academico y cientifico de nuestros recursos electronicos.'
value_why: Richest modern citation dictionary for archaic Greek in the A-E range (many lyric attestations with passage references).
effort_why: The licence is NC; SourceForge xDGE has no declared licence and no download count; unclear whether bulk TEI is retrievable.
restrictions: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 ES. Acknowledgement must include link to the latest version and consultation date. Public greeklyric.com is a risk if ever monetised; keep out of production unless owner accepts NC. Possible option: ask the DGE team for a permission letter.

name: Pape, Griechisch-deutsches Handworterbuch (3rd ed. 1914, Sengebusch) - digital forms
contents: Public-domain print (Pape d. 1854, Sengebusch d. 1881). Digital forms: Internet Archive scans (HandwrterbuchDerGriechischenSprache1, ...2, Google-Books copies such as bub_gb_bZkCAAAAMAAJ, rights marked Public Domain Mark 1.0); Zeno.org transcription; Roelli/Charbonnet text inside Eulexis (Pape.3.1.txt, 25 MB).
licence: Archive.org item metadata: licenseurl http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/ (for the Google-Books copies). No explicit licence found for Zeno.org or for the Roelli/Charbonnet text.
value_why: German definitions with many lyric quotations; print is certainly public domain, giving a legal route if a transcription with clear rights is found.
effort_why: Scans need OCR; the Zeno/Roelli transcription has no licence statement; Zeno.org terms of use not retrieved.
restrictions: Print PD; digitisations (Zeno, Roelli) rights unclear. Ask Philipp Roelli (digitiser) or Zeno for a licence before copying text.

name: LSJ - Perseus (PerseusDL/lexica)
contents: Perseus TEI of Liddell-Scott-Jones 9th ed. (CTS_XML_TEI), as already ingested by Melos.
licence: 'Unless otherwise indicated, all contents of this repository are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License. You must offer Perseus any modifications you make.'
value_why: Baseline; note the repo now says CC BY-SA 4.0 (older Hopper copy and cltk copy say CC BY-SA 3.0 and MPL 1.1).
effort_why: Already ingested.
restrictions: README caveat: 'Materials within the Perseus DL have varying copyright status'. CLTK greek_lexica_perseus README claims the older file is 'licensed under the Mozilla Public License 1.1'. Record the 4.0 licence at the pinned commit.

name: LSJ Logeion edition (helmadik/LSJLogeion) and related helmadik repositories
contents: LSJLogeion (CC BY-SA 4.0, pushed 2026-10-04); shortdefs (Greek-English short defs as used at Logeion), MiddleLiddell (middleLiddell02..25.xml), WoodhouseLogeion (English-Greek), LewisShortLogeion, morpheus fork.
size: LSJLogeion 2.3 GB repo size (XML 86 files, 115 MB)
licence: LSJLogeion LICENSE.md: 'This work is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International'. shortdefs, MiddleLiddell, WoodhouseLogeion: no licence file (GitHub shows none); shortdefs README asks for credit.
have_it: partial (LSJLogeion in production; MiddleLiddell from Perseus Hopper; shortdefs not ingested)
value_why: shortdefs is the very glosses Logeion shows; still no licence as of today.
effort_why: Writing to Helma Dik for a licence on shortdefs/MiddleLiddell/Woodhouse is cheap.
restrictions: Credit Perseus and Helma Dik/Logeion. Do not ingest unlicensed repos without her permission.

name: LSJ Supplement (1968) and Revised Supplement (1996)
contents: Oxford University Press supplements (Barber 1968; Glare/Thompson 1996, ~26,000 articles). Digital: Logos merges the Revised Supplement into LSJ (commercial); TLG online LSJ (subscription). No open digital edition found; no evidence that Perseus or Logeion include it.
licence: copyright OUP; no open licence found
value_why: Would add many lyric and papyrus words, but no legal source.
effort_why: No open source.
restrictions: Copyright. Not available.

name: Cunliffe and Autenrieth (gregorycrane/Homerica); Dodson; Abbott-Smith
contents: Homerica holds autenrieth.xml, cunliffe.lexentries.unicode.xml, cunliffe.hompers.unicode.xml, Monro grammar TEI (Monro2TEI.ipynb), homer-lmorph.txt, Tb+Morpheus. Dodson Greek Lexicon (NT) and Abbott-Smith (NT).
licence: Homerica: no licence file. Dodson: CC0-1.0 (repo licence). Abbott-Smith (translatable-exegetical-tools): no licence file.
have_it: yes (Autenrieth, Cunliffe unknown licence; Dodson CC0); Abbott-Smith no
value_why: Already held. The unexamined Homerica extras (Monro grammar TEI, homer-lmorph.txt, Tb+Morpheus) may help Homeric forms.
effort_why: Ask Gregory Crane for a licence statement on Homerica.
restrictions: No licence for Homerica or Abbott-Smith; print works are public domain.

name: Slater, Lexicon to Pindar (1969)
contents: Full-word lexicon to Pindar (De Gruyter); searchable on Chicago's Perseus-under-PhiloLogic. De Gruyter ebook 10.1515/9783110839289 is restricted access.
licence: copyright De Gruyter; the Chicago page states no licence
value_why: The standard Pindar lexicon, but not legally obtainable as data.
effort_why: Would need De Gruyter permission.
restrictions: Do not scrape the Chicago PhiloLogic page; no terms stated.

name: Rumpel, Lexicon Pindaricum (1883) and Ebeling, Lexicon Homericum (1880-85) scans
contents: Public-domain Latin lexica. Archive.org: lexiconpindaricu00rumpuoft (Rumpel, 1883, Toronto copy); lexiconhomericum01ebeluoft / lexiconhomericum02ebeluoft (Ebeling). TU Wien repository also hosts Ebeling vols 1-2 (doi 10.34726/dig.17909458 and 10.34726/dig.17909438) marked Public Domain Mark 1.0.
licence: TU Wien records: 'Public Domain Mark 1.0'; archive.org items carry no licenseurl field (public domain by date)
value_why: Rumpel lists every Pindaric word form with passages; Ebeling covers Homeric. Useful as a PD cross-check for Pindar forms and as OCR-able quotation index.
effort_why: OCR of Greek in Latin lexica is noisy and needs proofing; TU Wien notes some files are embargoed until 2031-2036.
restrictions: Original works public domain. Use full-view scans only; check each TU Wien file.

name: Stephanus, Thesaurus Graecae Linguae (Hase/Dindorf ed., scans)
contents: Scans of the Paris Didot edition (1831-65) on Internet Archive (bub_gb_OKU_AAAAcAAJ, bub_gb_ajU_AAAAcAAJ, bub_gb_yQR2LAgk2rEC; tgl-vol-5, tgl-prospectus-13). Biblissima also has a IIIF copy with full-text search.
licence: archive.org metadata licenseurl http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/ (Google Books copies)
value_why: Latin glosses and enormous citations, but very hard OCR.
effort_why: No clean text found.
restrictions: PD scans only; no bulk OCR text confirmed.

name: Brasse, Greek Gradus (1828/1842) and Maltby, New and Complete Greek Gradus (1850)
contents: Prosodial lexica giving the quantity of each syllable of Greek poetic words with citations (1828 and 1842 Brasse; 1850 Maltby). Public-domain scans on Internet Archive (greekgradusorgre00brasrich, greekgradus00bras, newcompletegreek00malt).
licence: no licence field; public domain by date (author d. 1833)
value_why: Historic dichrona-quantity evidence per word; useful as an independent cross-check of vowel lengths in lyric.
effort_why: Greek OCR, abbreviated entries.
restrictions: None; verify scans are full view.

name: Powell, Lexicon to Herodotus (1938); Frisk GEW; Chantraine DELG; Beekes EDG; Montanari GI/GE; Rocci; Gemoll/Passow/Benseler
contents: Group row of copyright or unclear works searched (EN/DE/FR/IT/ES). Powell (CUP 1938, reprinted Olms 1966/1977): no free full text found. Chantraine DELG (Klincksieck): no free digital edition found. Montanari GI/GE: commercial (digital included with printed GI; app removed from Google Play 2025-02-15). Rocci: Italian publisher rights; only the 1939 original could be PD. Passow 1831 (4th ed.), Benseler 1886, Pape-Benseler Eigennamen 1911 exist as archive.org/MDZ scans; Gemoll rights unclear. Frisk and Beekes: no open edition found.
licence: no open licence found for any of these
value_why: Not legally usable as data (Powell is probably not US public domain before 2034 if renewed; not verified).
effort_why: Rights clearance needed.
restrictions: Treat as copyright. Passow, Pape-Benseler and Benseler scans are public domain prints (archive.org, MDZ, Wikisource lists) but have no clean text.

name: Suda On Line (SOL): Byzantine Lexicography
contents: English translations and annotations of all ~30,000 Suda entries (Adler numbers); Greek text searchable (Betacode).
licence: 'The translations and annotations in the Suda On Line are covered by a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike License.'
value_why: Many glosses of rare lyric words, but NC.
effort_why: No bulk export; Greek text via Guest login search only (site footer says 'All rights reserved').
restrictions: CC BY-NC-SA; site footer 'All rights reserved'; no download. Do not scrape.

name: Lexicon of Greek Personal Names (LGPN) data
contents: Oxford relational database of Greek personal names, places, dates, references (500 BC-600 AD); ORA deposit 2019.
licence: 'Researchers are welcome to use the data for their own purposes but should acknowledge the original source, and re-use should not be for commercial purposes.' (Oxford ORA record). A third-party catalogue (Open EpiHub) lists CC BY 4.0, not confirmed.
value_why: Names in lyric (Sappho's circle etc.) could be linked, but the licence is non-commercial.
effort_why: ORA download format not stated.
restrictions: Non-commercial re-use; acknowledge source. Ask LGPN.

name: Wiktionary / kaikki Ancient Greek (macron and breve coverage)
contents: Wiktionary Ancient Greek via wiktextract JSONL. Melos's own copy (data/wiktionary.sqlite, 68,196 entries) has 49,515 entries (73%) with at least one macron or breve character (headword forms, romanisation, etymology, tables) and 43,614 with an IPA length mark. Wiktionary convention: 'please always mark the length of the monophthongs (single vowels) alpha iota upsilon if you are able to, using a macron or breve'; 'In Wiktionary, an unmarked vowel is considered ambiguous; short vowels should be marked with breves.'
licence: 'The original texts of Wiktionary entries are dual-licensed ... under both the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License (CC-BY-SA) and the GNU Free Documentation License (GFDL).'
value_why: Largest existing open source of vowel length attached to headwords and inflected forms; already on disk. Mining macron strings from forms/tables gives a quantity lexicon candidate (needs the conservative reading: unmarked is ambiguous, not short).
effort_why: Data in hand; need an extractor that splits headword/form macron data and maps to lemmas. The Macronizer author notes Wiktionary decisions on superheavy syllables can be unfounded (docs/method.md).
restrictions: CC BY-SA 4.0 + GFDL, attribution; keep as separate reference index as docs require. Quantities are editor-supplied and not systematic.

name: Morpheus: alpheios-project/morpheus, PerseusDL/morpheus, perseids-tools/morpheus, helmadik/morpheus
contents: Perseus Greek/Latin morphological analyser and stemlib; Alpheios fork carries Helma Dik's stem fixes; perseids-tools version is packaged for use. Morpheus output marks vowel length in stems and endings.
licence: PerseusDL/morpheus README: 'Unless otherwise indicated, all contents of this repository are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 United States License.' perseids-tools/morpheus: MPL-2.0 (GitHub). alpheios-project/morpheus LICENSE: fork of Perseus morpheus, 'While it does not explicity assign a license to morpheus, the Perseus Digital Library's github repository ... provides the following information'.
value_why: Source of inflected-form quantities; the macronizer, Eulexis and Diogenes tables are all downstream of it.
effort_why: Already built.
restrictions: CC BY-SA 3.0 US; keep the machine-output label.

name: Diogenes (pjheslin/diogenes) and morpheus-v3 data (grc.morph.xz)
contents: Peter Heslin's Diogenes uses an older Morpheus v3 table grc.morph (grc.morph.xz) and Logeion/Perseus lexica via makefiles. morpheus-v3 repo holds grc.morph.xz and lat.morph.xz (13 KB repo listing; compressed).
licence: Diogenes: 'The project as a whole is licensed under the GPLv3 or later.' pjheslin/morpheus-v3: no licence file.
value_why: Offline form-to-analysis table (Perseus/TLG-based) with dialect tags; alternative to hosted Morpheus.
effort_why: Unknown format, licence missing on data.
restrictions: No data licence on morpheus-v3. Ask Heslin.

name: cltk/greek_lexica_perseus and cltk/grc_models_cltk (CLTK data)
contents: greek-analyses.txt/json (Morpheus form analyses), greek-lemmata.txt, LSJ XML, scripts; grc_models_cltk: taggers and tokenizers.
licence: greek_lexica_perseus README: the LSJ file 'comes from Perseus ... and licensed under the Mozilla Public License 1.1 (MPL 1.1)'; no repo licence. grc_models_cltk: MIT (GitHub). CLTK code: MIT.
value_why: Old (2020) snapshot of Perseus analyses.
effort_why: Superseded by Morpheus build.
restrictions: Old-licence statements; prefer current Perseus.

name: jtauber/greek-inflexion and greek-accentuation
contents: Python library generating Ancient Greek paradigms with stem lexica (STEM_DATA: homer_lexicon.yaml 201 KB, morphgnt_lexicon.yaml, lxx_lexicon.yaml, ltrg, dik, pratt); stems like 'asa/asa-' with macron forms; Homer paradigm tables; greek-accentuation handles syllabification and accent rules incl. vowel length.
licence: MIT License, Copyright (c) 2014-2016 James Tauber (greek-inflexion); greek-accentuation MIT (GitHub)
value_why: A generator for regular forms with quantity-aware stems for Homeric verbs; code useful for accent-based length inference (penult/ultima rules).
effort_why: Limited to verbs and Homeric/NT vocabulary; stem data is 'work in progress'.
restrictions: MIT.

name: MorphGNT / SBLGNT
contents: NT morphology and lemmas.
licence: 'The SBLGNT text itself is subject to the SBLGNT EULA'; MorphGNT annotations 'CC-BY-SA License'
value_why: New Testament only; no lyric.
effort_why: n/a
restrictions: EULA on text.

name: Diorisis Ancient Greek Corpus (figshare) and HF conversion
contents: 820 literary texts, 10,206,421 words, lemmas and morphological analyses by Morpheus plus TreeTagger disambiguation; JSON version 1.51 (figshare 12251468, 163 MB); HF conversion tadad/diorisis-ancient-greek (538,001 sentences; 497 works at v1.6 and 323 at v1.51; 10,203,006 word tokens).
licence: figshare licence field: 'CC BY 4.0' (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). HF card: license other.
value_why: Automatic lemmas with all candidate Morpheus parses; form list for coverage; source texts include Perseus (CC BY-SA).
effort_why: Large XML/JSON; check lyric file list (Bibliotheca Augustana and Perseus sources).
restrictions: CC BY 4.0 on annotations; Perseus-derived texts keep BY-SA notices. Automatic, not attested.

name: GLAUx (alekkeersmaekers/glaux)
contents: 1,421 texts, ~20M tokens, automatic morphology, lemmas, dependencies (some manual); metadata.txt gives SOURCE_LICENSE per text. Lyric: Pindar 24,857 tokens, Theognis 11,484, Bacchylides 5,549, Simonides 1,882, Anacreon 3,005, Sappho 83 (Pedalion manual).
licence: 'Most of the data is available under a CC BY-SA license but some texts are more restrictive (e.g. CC BY-NC): the license of each source text is also specified in the metadata file.' Counts in metadata.txt (read 2026-10-09): CC BY-SA 4.0 = 999; CC-BY-SA 3.0 = 227; NA = 174; CC BY 4.0 = 10; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 = 3; CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 = 2; others 1 each (OpenEdition, GPL, CC BY-NC-ND 2.0/3.0, CC BY-SA 2.0/2.5).
value_why: Best large lemmatised corpus with lyric coverage (Pindar, Theognis, Bacchylides) and per-text licences.
effort_why: NFD XML; filter by licence column; exclude NA/NC/ND.
restrictions: Per-text licences; skip NA, NC, ND rows. Annotation is mostly automatic.

name: AGDT / Perseus treebank data (PerseusDL/treebank_data, v1.6, v2.0, v2.1, AGDT2)
contents: Hand-annotated Ancient Greek Dependency Treebank: Homer, Hesiod, tragedy, Athenaeus, Polybius, Plutarch etc.; folders v1.6, v2.0, v2.1 (Greek, Latin), AGDT2. Melos has v1.6 (478k tokens). No lyric.
licence: 'Contents of this repository are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 United States License.'
value_why: v2.1 may add texts beyond v1.6; manual gold.
effort_why: Same format as v1.6; diff the Greek folder.
restrictions: CC BY-SA 3.0 US. Note: cltk/greek_treebank_perseus copy of AGDT 1.7 says CC BY-NC-SA 2.5 (older), so use the Perseus repo.

name: Pedalion Trees (perseids-publications/pedalion-trees) and Harrington/Gorman trees
contents: Sappho (4,530 words), a 1.5K-token lyric set (Theocritus, Mimnermus, Semonides) and more, manually annotated in AGDT style (Leuven).
licence: Repo LICENSE: MIT (code). README: 'We will assign a Creative-Commons licence to our treebanks, probably the following one: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/.' GLAUx README: 'The Pedalion Trees ... available under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license.' Gorman trees per GLAUx README: 'CC BY-NC-SA 4.0'.
value_why: Only manual Aeolic (Sappho) syntax annotations; as of 2026-10-09 the licence is still 'probably' CC BY-SA 4.0 in the README (not changed since 2020 push history shows 2023-01-24).
effort_why: Small; email Leuven team to confirm licence first.
restrictions: Licence not yet formally assigned; contact Toon Van Hal or Alek Keersmaekers.

name: PapyGreek treebanks (papyri, documentary Greek)
contents: Manually annotated documentary papyri with literary and orthographic regularisation layers.
licence: 'The treebanks are licensed under a CC BY-SA 4.0 License (see LICENSE file).'
value_why: Documentary Greek; helps with Koine forms, not lyric.
effort_why: AGDT-like XML.
restrictions: CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: NC-restricted treebanks and lemmatised corpora: PROIEL, UD Perseus, UD PROIEL, Celano, Gorman
contents: UD_Ancient_Greek-Perseus (CoNLL-U of AGDT), UD_Ancient_Greek-PROIEL (NT, Herodotus), UD_Ancient_Greek-PTNK (Pentateuch/Tanach, CC BY-SA 4.0), gcelano/LemmatizedAncientGreekXML (25.5M tokens), vgorman1/Greek-Dependency-Trees.
licence: UD Perseus LICENSE: 'Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial- ShareAlike 2.5 Generic License'; UD PROIEL: 'License: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0'; UD PTNK: 'License: CC BY-SA 4.0'; Celano: 'Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International License'.
value_why: Same texts available more openly elsewhere (AGDT, GLAUx, OGA).
effort_why: Skip.
restrictions: NC. Note: NLP models trained on these (greCy, UDPipe, stanza) may inherit questions about derived-work terms.

name: Opera Graeca Adnotata (OGA) v0.2.0
contents: 1,999 base texts, 40M+ tokens from canonical-greekLit, First1KGreek and the Patristic Text Archive with nine layers: tokenisation, sentences, lemma, morphology, dependency structure and function, experimental IPA transcription (5th-century Attic, ByT5 model accuracy 0.83 vs Wiktionary), composition date, CTS structure.
licence: GitHub README: 'This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License'; Zenodo page: 'Creative Commons Attribution Share Alike 4.0 International' (API licence id shows 'other-at'); project site: 'The content is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0'.
have_it: partial (Melos uses OGA for metadata via OGC, not the full layers)
value_why: Largest lemma/morphology corpus under a clear share-alike licence; contains the lyric authors' texts and IPA layer that may carry length (ː).
effort_why: 8.6 GB archive; download on Basecamp; automatic annotation.
restrictions: CC BY-SA 4.0; machine annotation by Celano's parser.

name: Ancient Greek WordNet 0.5 (CNR-ILC; wn-data-grc.tab)
contents: 7,447 synsets, 22,420 lemmas, 76,620 senses bootstrapped from LSJ, Middle Liddell and Autenrieth (via Latin WordNet IDs); about 18% LSJ lemma coverage; not manually corrected. Also CLARIN-IT handle 20.500.11752/ILC-56 and jcuenod/greekwordnet (GPL-3.0 code).
licence: 'License: Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0 International' (README, Copyright 2016 CNR-ILC)
value_why: Semantic links, low precision.
effort_why: Tab file.
restrictions: Low precision; the CHS API (greekwordnet.chs.harvard.edu) newer data has no licence statement found.

name: Large Greek text datasets on HuggingFace (Ericu950/AncientGreek, Urdatorn/AncientGreek-no-sphragis, eulogikon/ancient-greek-texts)
contents: Ericu950/AncientGreek: ~361M words, 2.1M records, re-OCR'd archive.org and PleIAs public-domain page images plus OGA, DDbDP, DCLP, PG, SBLGNT, with per-record licence; Urdatorn variant 'no-sphragis'; eulogikon/ancient-greek-texts (Public Domain Mark).
licence: Ericu950/AncientGreek: license cc-by-sa-4.0 (mixed; README: per-record licence field); eulogikon: 'license_name: public-domain-mark-1.0'.
value_why: Texts, not lexica; useful only as additional frequency/context data.
effort_why: Large, OCR-repaired by LLM (not verbatim sources).
restrictions: LLM-repaired text must not be used as editions. Mixed licence compilation.

name: OdyCy, greCy, Stanza grc, CLTK (NLP pipelines)
contents: OdyCy spaCy models (sm 101 MB, trf 2.1 GB) for lemma/POS/morph/dependency; greCy (jmyerston/greCy, spaCy models trained on UD Perseus and PROIEL); stanfordnlp/stanza-grc (5.4 GB, Perseus/PROIEL models); CLTK 2.x (MIT).
licence: OdyCy: 'license: mit' (HF); greCy: MIT (GitHub), 'The models were trained using the Perseus and Proiel UD corpora'; stanza-grc: 'license: apache-2.0' (HF); CLTK: MIT (GitHub).
value_why: OdyCy is already held; stanza and greCy are alternatives for contextual lemmatisation.
effort_why: pip install; but benchmark first.
restrictions: Models trained on NC treebanks (UD Perseus CC BY-NC-SA 2.5, PROIEL CC BY-NC-SA 3.0): training-data terms may carry through to the weights; unresolved.

name: GreBerta, PhilBerta, SPhilBerta, GreTa, PhilTa (bowphs)
contents: Ancient Greek/Latin RoBERTa and T5 models and a sentence-transformer (SPhilBerta).
licence: license: apache-2.0 (HF metadata for each of GreBerta, PhilBerta, SPhilBerta, GreTa, PhilTa)
value_why: Embeddings, not required for the lexicon.
effort_why: HF download.
restrictions: Apache-2.0.

name: Ancient-Greek-BERT (pranaydeeps) and other community models
contents: BERT for Ancient Greek (903 MB); GitHub repo with SuperPeitho-FLAIR-v2 POS/morph tagger; Paulanerus/AncientGreekVariantSBERT (MIT); UGARIT/grc-alignment (cc-by-4.0); UGARIT flair_grc_bert_ner (no licence); lgessler/microbert-ancient-greek (no licence); prhbrt inscription lemmatisers (no licence).
licence: HF Ancient-Greek-BERT: no licence in metadata; GitHub repo: GPL-3.0; Paulanerus: 'license: mit'; UGARIT/grc-alignment: 'license: cc-by-4.0'
value_why: Not needed for dictionary work.
effort_why: n/a
restrictions: Licence missing on several.

name: Smith's dictionaries and other reference works in PerseusDL/canonical-pdlrefwk
contents: CTS-TEI reference works: viaf88890045 (Smith, William; three large XML files of 24 to 36 MB, including perseus-eng1.xml) and other VIAF folders (e.g. viaf66541464.001.perseus-eng1.xml 20 MB).
licence: 'Note these texts may be freely distributed under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license' (README); license.md is CC BY-SA 4.0
value_why: Smith's dictionaries of biography, geography and antiquities - Greek proper names and realia around lyric poets.
effort_why: TEI XML; map to proper-name lemmas.
restrictions: CC BY-SA 4.0. Exact contents of each VIAF folder not verified (only the Smith group name was read).

name: Grammars: Smyth, Goodwin, Monro, Buck, Thumb (archive.org scans, Perseus, Homerica)
contents: Public-domain grammars: Smyth, Greek Grammar for Colleges (rosettaproject_grc_morsyn-1; licenseurl publicdomain), Goodwin (rosettaproject_grc_morsyn-2; greekgrammar00gooduoft), Monro, Grammar of the Homeric Dialect (grammarofhomeric00monruoft; Monro TEI notebook in Homerica), Buck, Introduction to the Study of the Greek Dialects 1910 (cu31924031214822) and 1928 revised (IntroductiontoGreekDialects, Public Domain Mark 1.0). Thumb's Handbuch on archive.org is the modern Greek handbook (CC BY-NC-SA), not the dialect book.
licence: Smyth/Goodwin rosettaproject items: licenseurl http://creativecommons.org/licenses/publicdomain/; Buck 1928: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/
value_why: Reference only; Buck gives Aeolic, Doric dialect forms for checking Morpheus dialect output. Perseus's own Smyth text was not checked here.
effort_why: OCR cleanup needed.
restrictions: Prints are public domain.

name: Other Greek metre data: Palatine Anthology Book 1 (JOHD), Meters of Greek Drama (WashU), greek_metre, sedes
contents: JOHD 2026 dataset: metrical and prosodic analysis of 123 epigrams/500 lines of Palatine Anthology Book 1 with syllable quantity, xlsx plus three hyphenation CSVs. Meters of Greek Drama: Euripides Electra, Hecuba, Orestes metres. francescomambrini/greek_metre: 2017 pilot on metrical annotation. sasansom/sedes: metrical position in hexameter.
licence: JOHD dataset: 'The database and text are covered by CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 DEED.' MGD: no licence stated. greek_metre and sedes: no licence.
value_why: Not lyric of the right period; JOHD is NC.
effort_why: n/a
restrictions: NC for JOHD; others unlicensed.

name: Logeion and anastrophe dumps (status unchanged)
contents: Re-checked only via earlier notes in docs/plans/logeion-and-form-tables.md: no public licence or terms; private API key; SourceForge dumps from 2013 without licence; Logeion's data is reachable only through helmadik GitHub (LSJ CC BY-SA 4.0).
licence: no licence stated
value_why: Open parts already taken from helmadik.
effort_why: Contact Helma Dik.
restrictions: No scraping, no API use.
